mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RFRSH_TKN ( MBR_SN , RFRSH_TKN_HASH , EXPRY_DT , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{token.mbrSn} , #{token.rfrshTknHash} , DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{expirySeconds} SECOND) , NOW() , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT RFRSH_TKN_SN , MBR_SN , RFRSH_TKN_HASH , EXPRY_DT , DSCD_DT , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM RFRSH_TKN WHERE RFRSH_TKN_HASH = #{rfrshTknHash} AND DSCD_DT IS NULL AND EXPRY_DT > NOW()
